name: new-component
tagline_zh: 说一句“建个按钮”，它立刻生成组件、测试和Storybook故事。不用记目录结构，自动匹配你项目的PascalCa。
tagline_en: Say "make a button" and get component, test & Storybook files instantly, matching your project's PascalCase.
desc_en: Scaffold a new React component with optional Storybook story and Vitest test files. Use this skill whenever the user asks to "create a component", "make a button", "scaffold a card", "add a new component", or asks for a new file under `app/components/` following the project's component pattern (PascalCase folder, index.tsx, tests/).
why_zh: 它不只是生成文件，而是按你项目现有组件模式定制，连测试和故事都一并配好，省去手动对齐的麻烦。
why_en: It scaffolds files matching your existing component pattern, including tests and stories, so you skip manual alignment.
